# mtncloud_domains (Data Source)

Lists your domains, including those made in the console. Network domains instances can join. Domain join credentials are never read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_domains" "all" {}

output "domains" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_domains.all.domains : x.id => { name = x.name, fqdn = x.fqdn } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_regex` (String) Only return domains whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) The domains, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether it is active.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `display_name` (String) Display name, or empty.
- `fqdn` (String) Fully qualified domain name, or empty.
- `id` (Number) ID of the domain.
- `name` (String) Name of the domain.
- `public_zone` (Boolean) Whether it is a public DNS zone.
- `visibility` (String) `private` or `public`.
